top_signals.title: S&P 500 Falls as Oil Climbs Before Inflation Data: Markets Wrap
top_signals.summary: Wall Street refrained from making big bets on stocks and bonds ahead of a key inflation report, with oil resuming its advance as traders assessed the latest developments in the Middle East.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Indonesia Copper Shipments Delayed by Gresik Smelter Outage
top_signals.summary: Copper shipments from Indonesia are suffering delays after the smelter that processes ore from the giant Grasberg mine was halted because of a boiler leak over the weekend.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.
